behavior: Given a sanitized normalized record whose namespace, pod, container, workload, observedAt, source, message, and test.run_id all have distinct values, indexing and then retrieving it through the index port backed by real OpenSearch returns those values unchanged.
rationale: The defect can occur only across document serialization, the real OpenSearch mapping, and result deserialization; a boundary contract with distinct literals detects omitted, swapped, or incorrectly typed searchable fields.
